scope: VAE decoder channel-first RMS normalization (bf16 [C][H*W], one frame) with gamma, zero bias and optional fused SiLU; no fp32 temporaries
arithmetic: fp32 sum of squares per pixel, correctly rounded sqrt and division, bf16 RNE at each framework rounding point (normalize, scale, gamma, bias, SiLU); reduction order differs from the framework
abi: PaitonImage21VaeRmsNorm(x, gamma, out, channels, pixels, scale, eps, silu, hipStream_t) -> int (see vae_norm.hip)
